## Synopsis

```text
Meziantou.Framework.HtmlToMarkdown.Tool [options]
```

## Description

Convert HTML to Markdown using Meziantou.Framework.HtmlToMarkdown

## Options

| Option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--input <input>` | Path to the HTML file to convert. If omitted, reads from stdin |  |
| `--output <output>` | Path to the Markdown file to write. If omitted, writes to stdout |  |
| `--emphasis-marker <Asterisk\|Underscore>` | Marker used for emphasis | `Asterisk` |
| `--heading-style <Atx\|Setext>` | Style used for headings | `Atx` |
| `--code-block-style <Fenced\|Indented>` | Style used for code blocks | `Fenced` |
| `--code-block-fence-character <code-block-fence-character>` | Fence character used for fenced code blocks | `` ` `` |
| `--unordered-list-marker <unordered-list-marker>` | Marker used for unordered lists | `-` |
| `--thematic-break <thematic-break>` | Text used for horizontal rules | `---` |
| `--line-break-style <Backslash\|TrailingSpaces>` | Style used for line breaks | `TrailingSpaces` |
| `--simple-punctuation` | Convert smart punctuation characters to simple ASCII punctuation |  |
| `--emoji-shortcode-mode <GitHub\|None\|Unicode>` | Mode used to convert emoji to shortcodes | `None` |
| `--unknown-element-handling <PassThrough\|Strip\|StripKeepContent>` | Handling of unknown HTML elements | `PassThrough` |
| `--subscript-style <Html\|Text\|Tilde\|UnknownElement>` | Style used for subscript (sub) elements | `UnknownElement` |
| `--superscript-style <Caret\|Html\|Text\|UnknownElement>` | Style used for superscript (sup) elements | `UnknownElement` |
| `--underline-style <Html\|PlusSigns\|Text\|UnknownElement>` | Style used for underline (u) elements | `UnknownElement` |
| `--keyboard-style <CodeSpan\|Html\|Text\|UnknownElement>` | Style used for keyboard input (kbd) elements | `UnknownElement` |
| `--embedded-content-style <Html\|Link\|Remove\|UnknownElement>` | Style used for video, audio and iframe elements | `UnknownElement` |
| `--ignore-css-white-space` | Collapse the whitespace of the text even when a style attribute preserves it |  |
| `--table-span-handling <Duplicate\|EmptyCells\|Ignore>` | Handling of the colspan and rowspan attributes of table cells | `Ignore` |
| `--complex-table-handling <Flatten\|Html>` | Handling of the tables that a pipe table cannot represent | `Flatten` |
| `-?`, `-h`, `--help` | Show help and usage information |  |
| `--version` | Show version information |  |
